name: Ticker
description: Scrolls the text right to left like a news ticker.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var t="   "+el.text+"   ", L=t.length, w=Math.min(Math.round(p.width),L), off=Math.floor(env.absTime*p.speed)%L, s=""; for(var i=0;i<w;i++){ s+=t.charAt((off+i)%L); } el.text=s; return el; }
